subject: How to run mapreduce job on multiple cores?

messages.author: 8dfae3d986cfb6f4
messages.subject: How to run mapreduce job on multiple cores?
parts:
Each node in my cluster has 16 cores, I set the parameter
mapred.tasktracker.map.tasks.maximum <- 16. However I only see two of
the cpus are used at about 100% level on each node by the top
command . The memory usage is about 14% on each thread. How can I
utilize multiple cores to speed up the mapreduce job? Very appreciate
any of your help.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] How to run mapreduce job on multiple cores?
parts:
mapred.tasktracker.map.tasks.maximum is a site wide configurtion and
wont change per job.
Probably mapred.tasktracker.map.tasks.maximum is 2 in your
hadoop-site.xml? or something similar.
